about: Get your Dream Car: As soon as your dream car is confirmed, it is shipped to your nearest port with all the required documentation and delivered in a timely manner backed by a transit insurance policy. Before we deliver the car to the freight forwarder, our team inspects it thoroughly, and we send the buyer a checklist and pictures of the pre-delivery inspection.

SAHARA MOTORS DUBAI is well known for exporting Brand New Cars from Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We have been in the automobile export business for more than a decade. As a leading exporter of brand-new automobiles from Dubai, our company has built its reputation based on quality and service.
